newsitem.title: USA: Fonix in talks for possible alliances.
newsitem.headline: Fonix in talks for possible alliances.

text.p: Fonix Corp said Monday that it is talking with several "Fortune 100" companies about forming initial "next generation" speech technology joint ventures.
The company said any possible deals may include equity participation and strategic alliances with anticipated contract revenue for Fonix.
To help in finalizing these agreements, Fonix said it expects to engage the services of a specialized technology investment banking firm "in the near future."
No additional details were immediately available.
